# 0.5.0

## 本次更新

- 修复首页推荐下拉刷新过慢：下拉直接刷新推荐流，不再先做一次 WAF 敏感的首页探测（每次省约 1.5 秒）；失效会话仍会明确提示重新登录，CSRF 刷新与重试保留。
- 修复订阅/付费作品的锁标丢失：推荐流与详情的合并不再用缺少访问信息的后续数据覆盖已确认的订阅锁，卡片锁标与详情订阅提示稳定保留，避免把受限图误当成打码或坏图。
- 修复网页登录 challenge 循环：人机验证尝试超限后停止自动重载，不再无限重试触发验证。
- 新增网页会话未确认提示：会话未经服务端确认时首页明确提醒登录并刷新 Cookie，不再静默匿名。
- 修复仅因探测未确认的会话反复打扰登录：普通探测无法确认时不降级已登录会话，也不反复提示。
- 新增推荐请求耗时与每页锁定作品计数诊断日志。

- Fixes slow pull-to-refresh on the recommendation feed: a refresh now goes straight to the rfy request instead of running a WAF-sensitive home-page probe first (saving ~1.5s per pull); expired sessions still surface an explicit re-login entry, and the CSRF refresh/retry path is preserved.
- Fixes lost subscription locks: feed-to-detail merging no longer overwrites a confirmed subscription gate with later payloads lacking access metadata, so card badges and detail-page subscription notices stay stable instead of being mistaken for NSFW blur or a broken image.
- Fixes the web-login challenge loop: after the bot-check attempt limit is exceeded the page stops auto-reloading instead of re-triggering the challenge forever.
- Adds an explicit "web session not yet confirmed" reminder on Home so an unverified session prompts the user to log in and refresh cookies instead of silently going anonymous.
- Fixes nagging for probe-only unverified sessions: a bare probe that cannot confirm a signed-in session no longer downgrades it or repeatedly prompts.
- Adds diagnostic logs with request timing and a per-page count of gated artworks.
